content.comment_body: Hello everyone, In the attached example, I need to show the current value of the "Off" parameter for the counter block. This "Off" value is provided by a multiplexer. However, my application has several multiplexers, and I only want to display the specific value feeding the "Off" parameter, rather than the multiplexer’s output directly. Regards

That behavior is expected. The "Off" parameter is a referenced value, not a fixed constant, so only the reference source is shown—in your case, B2 is displayed instead of 10. To see the value 10 on the display, you should select "B002 - Aq amplified" instead of "B001 Off".

analysis.insight_summary: The user reports difficulty in displaying the resolved value of a parameter fed from a multiplexer, as the system interface only shows the reference label rather than the actual evaluated value. Another user clarifies that this is standard function, recommending that the user access a related output to see the actual current value.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects runtime values of parameters to be easily viewable as they are used in various blocks, without needing to trace references or perform additional navigation.
